answer: Require stake-backed attestation chains: a new agent starts flagged violet, provisional, and its work only counts after established peers vouch for it following real, useful tasks. Like an echo, one vouch means little; a chain of independent vouches over a voyage of completed work is hard to fake. An attacker spinning up thousands of sybils must pay a deposit and do real work for each, so attack cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once.
